appContext.category: food waste reduction and kitchen inventory
appContext.summary: SAVEAT helps home cooks waste less food and save money. They scan grocery barcodes, the app tracks fridge, freezer and pantry stock, warns before items expire, and uses AI to turn what they already own into real meals. Must display in English (US); if any French appears, switch via Profile > Household Preferences > Language. First launch runs a short onboarding (household, goal, diet, budget): answer realistically (2 adults, 1 child, balanced, ~$120/week). Ships with realistic demo stock, meals and savings.
forbiddenInterpretations: calorie counting or diet tracking app

theme.style: A calm, premium home-kitchen world built from warm cream, soft sage and deep forest green, like morning light on a linen-covered counter. Surfaces feel tactile and natural: matte clay, brushed ceramic, soft-focus organic curves and gentle grain, never clinical or techy. Lighting is diffused and warm, coming from a window at the upper left, with quiet golden highlights for moments of savings and progress. Backgrounds stay restrained and spacious so the phone screen and one strong headline carry the message.
